---
name: "LoopDev: Tracks: Review"
description: "Review a LoopDev track for phase readiness, evidence, risks, decisions, dependencies, and closure gaps."
argument-hint: "Track id or path"
agent: agent
---

Use the `track-governance` skill to review the requested track. Present findings first, ordered by
severity. Check metadata, phase status, evidence, unapproved changes, blockers, dependencies, and
closure criteria. Do not close or materially alter the track without explicit user approval.
